en: Colorized postcard view from the sea toward a coastal town with multi‑story buildings lining the waterfront and a fortification or citadel on a small hill in the background. A steamship with two masts and a central smokestack sails in the foreground. The sky is lightly clouded and the water appears calm. In the upper left corner is the caption 'Korfu.' and along the lower right edge is a printed website watermark.
